_about: Herodotus in English, translator per title. G. C. Macaulay (prose, 1890): vol. 1 is already held on the Adler shelf (herodotus-history, PG 2707) and is cross-referenced; vol. 2 (PG 2456) is fetched here, completing him. George Rawlinson (1858-60, with notes and essays by H. C. Rawlinson and J. G. Wilkinson), the 4-vol. 1861 New York printing, raw IA OCR. Older translations from the wishlist added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row).

herodotus-perseus-godley-histories: Translation published 1925: US public domain (in or before 1930). Perseus source line: Herodotus. Godley, Alfred Denis, translator. Cambridge, MA; London: Harvard University Press; William Heinemann, Ltd., 1920-1925 (printing). (Modernized by Perseus.) Perseus's header says the text 'was modernized by Steven Ott, to remove archaisms' and revised after review, so this witness is Godley's translation as modernized by Perseus, not as printed.
